citationText: 31 Shiller Karl Motion Picture Magazine , vol. 17 , p. 66 , March 1919 . Flame arc lamps for after dark photography, outdoors and indoors, for moonlight effects, for fireside effects and for war scenes. Night scenes are lighted by concentrating the arc light on central figures and leaving the surroundings in darkness in order to give the natural and romantic effect desired.
